# VirtualPC + Alexander — Top improvements (research 2026-06-04)

**86 codebase-grounded improvements** across VirtualPC (Node/TS, Express :3100) and Alexander (Python Symphony+). Generated by a research sweep of both codebases. Grouped P0 (broken/blocking) → P3 (nice-to-have).

## ✅ Delivered (branch `release/p0-security-stability`)

- **#4 / #14** — `workLog` capped at `MAX_WORKLOG=10000` with rolling eviction + tail-only replay of the persisted log. Was driving `task-state.json` to 196 MB (event-loop-blocking 5s save tick). *Takes effect on next service rebuild+restart, which re-saves the trimmed snapshot.*
- **#9** — `/api/tracks/:id` path-traversal guard (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]+` slug + resolved-path containment check).
- **#8 / #13** — `/api/docs/regenerate` scope allow-listed (`all|readme|architecture|wiki`) before reaching the spawned script.
- **#37** — global JSON Express error handler registered after all routes (no more HTML stack-trace leaks on the JSON API).
- **#11** — SocketIO CORS restricted from `origin: '*'` to a localhost allow-list (`SOCKET_CORS_ORIGINS` override).
- **#41** — `gh api` `execFile` given a 15s timeout so a hung GitHub call can't hang the awaiting request.
- **#31** — `FieldCrypto` (AES-256-GCM) wired to the credentials store: api_keys encrypted at rest, plaintext kept only in memory + `process.env`. Keyed off `FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (graceful plaintext fallback when unset), with transparent migration of any legacy plaintext file on load. 4 unit tests; live file has 0 providers so restart migration is a no-op.

*Skipped #33 (Kafka unhandled rejection): `bestEffortPublish` already wraps `ensureSharedProducer` + the publish callback in try/catch and never throws — not a real defect on inspection. #36 (cliLog unbounded): already capped at 200/agent and not persisted — non-issue.*

## ✅ Delivered (branch `release/p1-security-hardening`, stacked on p0)

Built with multi-agent recon → design → adversarial verification (ultracode).

- **#2** — `securityHeaders` wired with **safe-by-default gating**: SAMEORIGIN (not DENY, which blanked the dashboard iframe), CSP allows `https://unpkg.com` (Three.js demos) + cross-port localhost fetches + `object-src/base-uri/frame-ancestors`, HSTS gated on HTTPS. Strict mode (COEP/COOP/locked CSP) opt-in via `ENFORCE_STRICT_SECURITY`.
- **#3** — global per-IP rate limiter (default 1200/min, env-tunable, `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false` kill-switch). Socket.IO + the two canonical health probes exempt; NaN-safe env parsing; unref'd cleanup timer.
- **#19** — `internalWriteAuth` guards the 6 open write endpoints (loopback or `INTERNAL_WRITE_SERVICE_TOKEN`); **WARN by default** (non-breaking), `INTERNAL_WRITE_ENFORCE=true` rejects. Path normalised (case + trailing slash) to close the routing bypass.
- *Adversarial panel caught 3 critical defects pre-merge (trailing-slash auth bypass, `/x/health` rate-limit bypass, NaN-disables-limiter) — all fixed with regression tests. 28 unit tests.*

Remaining items below. *Alexander-side items (`src/alexander/...`) live in the separate Alexander repo — fix there under its own lease.*

---

**Notable themes:** (1) several security-defined-but-not-wired modules (rateLimiter, securityHeaders, fieldCrypto) — quick high-value fixes; (2) unbounded-growth files (task-state.json 194MB, events.jsonl 188MB, lightrag.db 166MB) need rotation/caps; (3) the OpenClaw command dispatcher is mocked — real agent dispatch is the big unlock; (4) Alexander lacks CI + type-checking. Cross-reference the existing `.backlog/{high,medium,low}-priority.md` before scheduling.
